trail.text: Latency is spiking across travel and route services — now digging in to trace the fault.
Route shows latency while its downstream looks healthy, so it may be the bottleneck — now checking its scope and timing.
Early timing looks nearly simultaneous — now broadening the search for the true origin.
Median versus tail patterns aren't pointing to a single caller — now hunting for a shared dependency.

causes.reasoning: Route p99 steps immediately to flat ~2.1s and stays flat, classic injected delay; downstream train/station normal so not a victim of them, while upstream travel services amplify it.
Caller of route, p99 jumps to ~6.2s and p50 to 0.84s from blocking on slow route with thread-pool amplification.
Sibling caller of route with same pattern p99 ~5.9s, victim of shared route slowdown.
Upstream aggregator of travel/travel2, largest p99 ~14s with spikes to 34s, victim of travel cascade.
Food latency rises delayed and ramps to ~2.2s, consistent with indirect victim via travel/route dependency.
